1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium comprising water; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme selected from the group consisting of VISCOZYME@ and other cell wall degrading enzymes.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that are not yet fully developed.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent condition prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is molecular marker analysis including genotyping.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype through a method that includes automated analysis.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos, wherein the selection process is at least partially automated.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated and facilitated through a computer software program.
